title: Murders at Karlov Manor: card flavor text

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A pompous but gifted detective of Ravnica who investigates Teysa's murder and breaks Etrata out of an Azorius cell.

entities.name: Teysa
entities.description: Head of the Karlov Manor household and leader of the Syndicate who was murdered at her party.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: The invitation-only manor where Teysa's party took place.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city-plane governed by guilds.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who pursues Teysa's murderer and chases Etrata.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young detective who works with Kaya and Agrus Kos.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A veteran Agency detective who works to bring Teysa's murderer to justice.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A master assassin who cannot remember killing Zegana and whom Proft breaks out of an Azorius cell.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A guest at Teysa's party whose body was found, a murder victim.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: Owner and star of Hellbender who plots against Proft and Agrus.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A killer whom Judith directs against Proft.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Leader of the Boros Legion who gave the Agency an ultimatum after an attempt on her life.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Boros guild which Aurelia musters for war against the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The Rakdos guild.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Patron of Chaos and signatory of the original Guildpact, over 10,000 years old.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: Chief of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations.

entities.name: Tam Sennic
entities.description: Ezrim's second-in-command.

entities.name: Agency
entities.description: The investigative agency led by Ezrim.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The lawmaking guild that runs verity circles and holds Etrata in a cell.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: A guild shunned for opening the doors to Phyrexia; its poison and recycling are mentioned.

entities.name: Foundway Associates
entities.description: A group of investigators whose members include Skurad, Linghu, Dvika, Udol, Imel, Runubi, Algrom, Alst, Thare and Taboro.

entities.name: Oba

entities.name: Realmbreaker

events.summary: Teysa's party ends as guests gather around Zegana's body and realize it is a murder with the killer among them.
events.quote: it was a murder, the killer was likely among them, and Teysa's party was definitely over.

events.summary: Alquist Proft tells the gathered suspects the killer is in the room.
events.quote: our killer is here with us, in this very room.

events.summary: Proft arrives, introduces himself as a great detective and identifies the culprit within minutes.
events.quote: then identified the culprit within minutes.

events.summary: Kaya traps a thrashing dryad in a barrier ward.
events.quote: Kaya clung to the cords of the barrier ward with all her might, trapping the thrashing dryad like a fly in a spider's web.

events.summary: Kaya, Kellan and Agrus Kos agree to seek justice for Teysa's murderer.
events.quote: none of them would rest until Teysa's murderer was brought to justice.

events.summary: Proft breaks a notorious assassin out of an Azorius holding cell.
events.quote: Proft had never been a by-the-book investigator, but even he never expected to find himself breaking a notorious assassin out of a maximum-security Azorius holding cell.

events.summary: Etrata cannot remember killing Zegana despite recalling dozens of other murders.
events.quote: But no matter how hard she tried, she couldn't remember killing Zegana.

events.summary: Judith orders Massacre Girl to deal with Proft.
events.quote: Proft has been poking his nose where it doesn't belong. I want him out of the way.

events.summary: Judith's plan nears fruition and she cannot let Agrus interfere.
events.quote: Judith's plan was close to fruition. She couldn't have Agrus get in the way.

events.summary: Etrata evades the Boros and Azorius but not Kaya.
events.quote: Etrata evaded the Boros arresters and Azorius lawmages, but not even a master assassin could give Kaya the slip.

events.summary: After an attempt on her life, Aurelia gives the Agency a day to solve the case or the Boros will declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.
events.quote: solve the case in twenty-four hours, or the Boros Legion would declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.

events.summary: Kaya senses something off in Trostani when meeting her.
events.quote: Trostani was as regal and vibrant as ever, but Kaya couldn't shake the sense that there was something off
As if in answer, the robed figure lunged forward.

events.summary: Teysa's security failed, Etrata was locked up, and Kaya is left with a dead friend and questions.
events.quote: Teysa's security was unrivaled. Etrata was locked up. Kaya was left with nothing but multiplying questions... and a dead friend.

events.summary: Aurelia musters the Boros Legion as Kaya and Kellan race to prevent a guild war.
events.quote: While Aurelia mustered the Boros Legion, Kaya and Kellan raced against the clock, desperate to stave off a war the guilds might not survive.

events.summary: A speaker rages that those who hoarded supplies, profited from destruction or colluded with the invaders all deserved to die.
events.quote: They all deserved to die. And I'm not done yet!

events.summary: Proft notes Oba fought Realmbreaker's corruption alone and pities her.
events.quote: Oba fought Realmbreaker's corruption alone, hiding her pain even from her sisters.

events.summary: Proft recognizes the Cult of Rakdos's involvement as puzzling.
events.quote: Why would the Cult of Rakdos be involved at all?

relations.note: Proft broke her out and finds working with her not so bad.
relations.quote: It's not so bad working with Etrata.

relations.note: They agreed to pursue Teysa's murderer.
relations.quote: For all their differences, Kaya, Kellan, and Agrus Kos agreed on one thing

relations.note: Judith wants Proft out of the way.
relations.quote: Proft has been poking his nose where it doesn't belong. I want him out of the way.

relations.note: Judith gives orders to Massacre Girl.
relations.quote: I want him out of the way.
never forget that the most important person is the victim.
While Aurelia mustered the Boros Legion
Finally, a performance worthy of my applause!

relations.note: Oba is one of Trostani's sisters.
relations.quote: With the treacherous Oba separated from her sisters
